read_from: The route text as served: field 1 (the route text) of each row of reader/data/route-store of the main branch at commit 306f3b285898, store_version 87b13b1169b4 (its index.json), for "unfoldingWord Hebrew-Aramaic Lexicon" (M7): 286 routes (axis: routes), 77 letters keys (axis: keys). The definition field of the same row equals the route text on 286 of the routes. The source audit (builder/02-audit.mjs, evidence about the source and no part of any test): the source is the unfoldingWord lexicon in ledgers/work/ldmprs/source-cache/unfoldingword-uhal-2026-07-12/en_uhal/, one file to an entry, each sense with a Glosses field whose items stand between semicolons. Each of the 286 routes is one whole item of a Glosses field of a record of the dictionary store whose headword's letters equal the route's key, and comes from one entry, so a route comes from one field and no test here stands on a guess about a field. The source's own key to its signs was looked for: the 4 files of the copy that are no entry (LICENSE, Project Explanation.md, README.md, Volunteer job description.md). README.md says what a gloss is ("English translation equivalents in one or a few words") and that the starting point of the lexicon is the Brown-Driver-Briggs lexicon. No line of those files names a comma, semicolon, hyphen, apostrophe, bracket, slash or the words passive or reflexive (builder/05-key-search.mjs, source-audit/key-search.json), and none of the 5 marks of this ledger has its use stated there, so the meaning of all 5 shapes begins "unverified:".

definitions.terms: In every test a character is one Unicode code point (every route holds only characters of 16 bits, so a code point is one index of the JavaScript string). A letter is any character of Unicode category L (JavaScript \p{L}), of any script and in either case. No test asks for a digit, for whitespace, or for uppercase or lowercase as a class. Nothing is trimmed: the text is the whole route text as it stands, which is the field route of a line of the by-source JSONL, what the checker gives the classifier, and never the field def; the text before and the text after the mark are the template's c.before and c.after. Directly before and directly after name the one character next to the mark; where the mark stands at that end of the text no character stands there, so a test that asks for a character there fails. A text closes with a string when the last characters of the whole text are that string, character for character. What the pair holds is the template's c.group: the characters between an opener and its closer, nothing trimmed; it is one of a list's strings when it equals that string character for character. A string stands between « and », which are not part of it, and a full stop after » belongs to the sentence. Every string and every list minds case and is matched exact to the character. No test uses the words begins with or contains.
definitions.first_match: For each mark the shapes are tried in the order they stand in this file; the first whose test holds names the occurrence, and no later shape is tried for it. A shape's container field is not part of its test: no test here looks at the container, and the checker compares the field afterwards. An occurrence that no shape of its mark takes makes the classifier throw, and none does: no shape here takes an occurrence without a test.

homonyms.reason: The route text carries no entry number. The source's own files carry one that the route store dropped: each entry is its own file, named for its Strong's number (H0215.md), with that number under its Word data, and the dictionary store's record keeps the file's name and text; a route keeps neither. By the audit, of the 41 keys with more than one text (axis: keys), 39 have all their texts from one entry (its glosses) and 2 from two or more (example key אור, whose 13 texts come from the entries H0215 and H0216).

not_done_here: This ledger leaves to the store every route that holds no mark, because a shape stands only at a mark, and every question of whether a row should print under its key; the 36 rows it names for this stand in rows-for-the-store-v1.jsonl, outside the shapes, as what one reading found and no count of a class, and nothing is struck.
